Tested CrispEmbed OCR browser runtime, retained byte-for-byte for reproducible
builds. Source: https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispEmbed (MIT license).
Original runtime download: https://crispstrobe.github.io/CrispEmbed/
Wrapper source: https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispEmbed/blob/main/wasm/crispembed-ocr.js

The runtime checksums are pinned in scripts/sync-staff-omr-assets.mjs. Do not
replace these files or their pins without repeating the score recognition audit.

The TrOMR model is downloaded separately from revision
f7912e2c68d5d89c9ff2546bbbcc736268822af0 of https://huggingface.co/cstr/tromr-GGUF
and verified by SHA-256. Its Apache-2.0 license is included as TrOMR-LICENSE.txt.
